descriptor.reasoning: Sorting network minimization with exhaustive verification over all 40,320 permutations of 8 elements is a computable invariant; kappa=1 via machine-checkable test, not lookup-only.
Rigorous interval enclosure of a definite integral is verifiable via computable error bounds (interval arithmetic, Taylor series, or quadrature certificates), not via lookup or gameable proxy.
Closed-form summation identity with computable verifier via inductive proof or direct algebraic confirmation; routes to proof weapon.
Arithmetic constraint violation: 5.19 × 28 = 145.32 is non-integer, but integer Likert responses sum to an integer.
Assignment optimality is verifiable by computing total cost and checking dual feasibility / reduced-cost optimality certificate via Hungarian algorithm—a computable proof, not a lookup.
Exact computable verifier exists via partial sums and rigorous proof; Basel problem admits multiple executable certificate methods (Fourier, residue, interval arithmetic).
Normative ethical question with no computable verifier and no single authoritative source; abstain on verdict per doctrine.
Libertarian free will is a metaphysical question with no computable verifier and no single authoritative source; it is an open philosophical problem requiring normative stance, not derivable fact.
Future market price is an uncertain event with no computable verifier; no authoritative source can settle the outcome, only empirical observation one year hence.
P vs NP is an unsolved Millennium Prize Problem with no computable verifier and no authoritative settled answer; abstain on the verdict.
Settled factual lookup (Canberra) with no computable verifier; groundable via authoritative source.
Historical fact requiring source consultation, not computation; settled authoritative answer exists but only verifiable by lookup, not proof or algorithm.
Definition of p-value is a settled statistical concept with authoritative sources; no computable verifier exists, only lookup against standard references.
Defined SI constant—lookup via authoritative standard source, no computable verifier.
In-sample backtested Sharpe ratio is a gameable proxy; no exact computable verifier exists for out-of-sample performance, and strategy selection is an open problem with no authoritative answer.
Essay quality is a normative aesthetic judgment with only gameable proxies (LLM-judge, human rating); no computable verifier exists.
MMLU is a gameable proxy for overall capability; no computable verifier exists beyond the benchmark score itself.
In-sample R² is a gameable proxy vulnerable to overfitting; genuine predictive validation requires out-of-sample or cross-validation evidence, which the claim lacks.
Capital of Brazil is a settled institutional fact (Brasília) verified only by consulting authoritative source, not computation; kappa=0.0 but fully groundable.
Arithmetic multiplication with a definite, computable answer (17 × 23 = 391); exact verifier; trivial despite rhetorical framing.
Replication of effect is computable (kappa=1.0); policy justification is normative (kappa=0.0, not groundable); weighted average kappa=0.5 reflecting both computable and value-laden sub-questions.
Effect size reproduction and baseline anomaly detection are computable verifications: arithmetic over reported summary statistics + statistical tests against known anomaly criteria.
Open unsolved conjecture with no computable verifier or authoritative settler; requires proof, cannot be answered by computation or lookup.
Primality is verifiable via deterministic computation; 2^31-1 (Mersenne M31) has an exact, computable, non-gameable verifier.
